title: Arroz con Leche Recipe
hookLine: Global-inspired arroz con leche recipe with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: In a small pot, add water and cinnamon sticks, bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. Set aside and discard cinnamon sticks. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches. Incorporate {m53522_1}, {m53522_2}, {m53522_3}, and {m53522_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure rice first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Place the rice and the cinnamon water in a large saucepan, over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon. Incorporate {m53522_5}, {m53522_6}, {m53522_7}, {m53522_8}, and {m53522_9} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Add salt, butter, vanilla extract, 2 cups of milk, and sugar. Stir well to mix and cook uncovered for approximately 15 minutes. Whisk steadily around the bottom and corners of the pan until glossy, thickened, and smooth enough to coat the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Reduce heat to medium low. Add the remaining milk and condensed milk. Stir with a wooden spoon. Cook for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until the rice pudding thickens to desire consistency.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Stir well and remove from heat, and let it cool at room temperature. The consistency should be very creamy. Refrigerate for a least 1 hour or overnight.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
